steps.en: State Courts finish processing a batch and return the result
steps.id: State Courts selesai memproses satu batch dan mengembalikan hasilnya
steps.why_en: No court file transfer is set up; only other agencies have it.
steps.why_id: Belum ada pertukaran file court; hanya instansi lain yang ada.

steps.en: OCMS knows every notice in the batch is fully processed
steps.id: OCMS tahu semua notice dalam batch sudah selesai diproses
steps.why_en: No batch tracking exists, so completion cannot be detected.
steps.why_id: Belum ada pelacakan batch, jadi penyelesaian tidak bisa dideteksi.

steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that logs and does nothing.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang mencatat log.

steps.en: The work item shows on the OIC dashboard
steps.id: Work item tampil di dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty and the work item menu is switched off.
steps.why_id: Dashboard masih kosong dan menu work item dimatikan.

steps.why_en: No allocation or alert to an OIC is built.
steps.why_id: Belum ada penugasan atau alert ke OIC.
